understanding: Verify modem status interrupt where CTS DSR RI DCD toggles set MSR deltas cleared by MSR read and assert INT_O with IIR Modem Status only when IER bit3 enabled checked in modem agent and top scoreboard in normal mode with DLAB 0
preconditions: Bind modem_control_if to cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i drive plus rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o observe and interrupt_output to int_o observe and wishbone_slave_interface to wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_dat_o wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_ack_o wb_sel_i with wb_clk_i owned by clock and wb_rst_i owned by reset via common UVCs with polarity symbolic
Own every DUT input with uart_serial_data owning srx_pad_i tied idle for this feature and no floating inputs and all outputs observed only
Require normal operation MCR Loopback 0 with LCR DLAB 0 so modem registers accessible with MSR read at wb_adr_i pin value 6 width 8 read only and IER IIR pin values symbolic
Start from reset cleared FIFOs with all IER disabled then program divisor line FIFO base and IER bit3 per case 0 disabled versus 1 enabled
stimulus_steps: STAGE0_BRINGUP: wishbone_slave_interface WRITES divisor line FIFO base with LCR DLAB 0 and MCR Loopback 0 normal mode; WAIT reset release; BOUND by drain_cycles operational limit

STAGE1_DISABLED: wishbone_slave_interface WRITES IER bit3 0; FOR each line IN cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i: modem_control_if DRIVES single toggle via custom driver_body using modem_handshake_toggle test only infrastructure; wishbone_slave_interface READS MSR at pin 6; interrupt_output OBSERVES int_o via monitor_body

STAGE2_ENABLED: wishbone_slave_interface WRITES IER bit3 1; FOR each line IN cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i: modem_control_if DRIVES single toggle; wishbone_slave_interface READS MSR and IIR; interrupt_output OBSERVES int_o; per agent sequences drive only own interface and stages execute in order with concurrent wishbone modem interrupt observation
VIRTUAL_SPAWN_ONLY: virtual sequence SPAWNS listed per agent sequences with no VIFs or delays
STAGE3_CLEAR: wishbone_slave_interface READS MSR to clear deltas; WAIT drain_cycles; CLEANUP restores MCR Loopback 0 and LCR DLAB 0 with bus idle owned
check_steps: COMPARE MSR delta DCTS DDSR TERI DDCD set after corresponding cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i toggle and cleared after MSR read in modem agent and top scoreboard
COMPARE MSR status bits 4 to 7 complement of CTS DSR RI DCD in normal mode versus loopback remap excluded
COMPARE int_o negated when IER bit3 is 0 despite delta versus asserted when IER bit3 is 1 with IIR bit0 0 pending
COMPARE IIR bits 3 to 1 equals 000 4th Modem Status with reset control reading MSR and bit0 1 idle after clear respecting higher priority preemption
COMPARE top scoreboard end to end modem toggle to MSR to int_o to IIR with no loss duplication or misorder
completion: Done when IER disabled case shows MSR delta without int_o plus IER enabled cases show MSR delta with int_o and IIR 000 for each of CTS DSR RI DCD each with at least one scoreboard COMPARE
Bound by TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES plus drain_cycles and request_timeout_cycles operational limits where timeout is testbench limit not DUT timing
Cleanup restores MCR Loopback 0 and LCR DLAB 0 with wishbone bus idle owned for handoff

facts.statement: CTS DSR RI or DCD change produces 4th Modem Status interrupt cleared by reading Modem status register
facts.quote:
0 0 0 4 th Modem Status CTS, DSR, RI or DCD. Reading the Modem
status register.

facts.statement: IIR bit0 0 means interrupt pending with INT_O asserted and 1 means no interrupt with INT_O negated
facts.quote:
Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’. When it’s ‘1’ – no interrupt
is pending.

facts.statement: IIR reports Modem Status as 4th priority 000 below RLS RDA Timeout THRE with reset by MSR read
facts.quote:
0 0 0 4 th Modem Status CTS, DSR, RI or DCD. Reading the Modem
status register.

facts.statement: IER bit3 enables Modem Status interrupt 0 disabled 1 enabled
facts.quote:
3 RW Modem Status Interrupt
 ‘0’ – disabled
 ‘1’ – enabled

facts.statement: IER enables and disables UART interrupt generation subject to per bit enable
facts.quote: This register allows enabling and disabling interrupt generation by the UART.

facts.statement: MSR delta bits set to 1 on corresponding line change and reset on MSR read
facts.quote:
These bits are set to
‘1’ when a change in corresponding line has been detected and they are reset when the
register is being read.

facts.statement: MSR bit0 DCTS indicates CTS line changed state
facts.quote: ‘1’ – The CTS line has changed its state.

facts.statement: MSR bit1 DDSR indicates DSR line changed state
facts.quote: ‘1’ – The DSR line has changed its state.

facts.statement: MSR bit2 TERI detects RI low to high trailing edge
facts.quote:
Trailing Edge of Ring Indicator  (TERI) detector. The RI line has
changed its state from low to high state.

facts.statement: MSR bit3 DDCD indicates DCD line changed state
facts.quote: ‘1’ – The DCD line has changed its state.

facts.statement: MSR is 8 bit read only at bus address 6
After reset all interrupts disabled in IER
facts.quote: All interrupts are disabled in the Interrupt Enable Register.

facts.statement: Modem control handles RTS CTS DTR DSR RI DCD handshake
facts.quote:
The modem control register allows transferring control signals to a modem connected to
the UART.

facts.statement: MCR Loopback 0 is normal operation and 1 is loopback with STX held at 1
facts.quote:
‘0’ – normal operation
 ‘1’ – loopback mode. When in loopback mode, the Serial
Output Signal (STX_PAD_O) is set to logic ‘1’.

questions: What are confirmed wb_adr_i pin values for IER and IIR under DLAB 0 versus divisor under DLAB 1 plus wb_sel_i handling and reset release to first access delay
What is wb_rst_i polarity and int_o active polarity for assertion versus negation correlation with IIR bit0
What are inactive drive levels for cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i and tie off for srx_pad_i and idle ownership of wishbone bus during modem toggles
What exact IIR bits 3 to 1 and bit0 encoding must be observed for isolated Modem Status 000 versus concurrent higher priority RLS RDA Timeout THRE including bits 7 to 4
What MCR Loopback 0 versus 1 handling applies for normal external modem observation and are external modem inputs ignored in loopback when STX is held at 1
